## Description
A clear and concise description of what you'd like to see added or improved.

## Problem It Solves
What problem or pain point would this feature address?

## Research Modality
Is this relevant to a specific research modality?
- [ ] EEG/ERP
- [ ] fMRI
- [ ] Online Behavioral
- [ ] Psychophysiology
- [ ] All modalities
- [ ] Not modality-specific

## Proposed Solution
How do you envision this feature working? (Describe the ideal workflow)

## Alternatives Considered
Are there other ways to solve this problem?

## Additional Context
- Any relevant examples or use cases?
- Links to documentation or references?
- Sketches, mockups, or pseudocode?
